description: Use this once the user has seen and confirmed the job titles, location, work mode, job type and experience level AIApply needs: call it with confirmed=true and the values they confirmed, without asking them again. Without confirmed it only checks the values and saves nothing. Only for a first setup — once saved, preferences are changed in AIApply, never here. After it saves, call get_setup_status for the next step. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one. It also needs a permission the user grants; if it was not granted, calling it asks the user to allow it.

city.description: Optional: narrow the search to this city in that country.

confirmed.description: True only after the user has confirmed these exact values.

country.description: The country to work in, as a name or ISO code. WW for remote anywhere.

work_mode.description: in_person_hybrid for on-site or hybrid, full_remote for remote.

name: save_auto_apply_setup

dashboard_url.description: The AIApply dashboard, where the user manages Auto Apply.

field.description: The field to fix, when one was refused.

reason.description: Why nothing was saved, when nothing was.

saved.description: True when the setup was saved.

search_only_ends_at.description: When AIApply stops searching for this account, if it searches without applying.

searching.description: Whether AIApply now searches for this user.

updates_offer.description: Present once, when the account is first ready: something you may offer the user. Act on it only if they agree.

user_message.description: Show this to the user rather than message.

values.description: The values as they are, or will be, saved.

title: Save the AIApply job setup
